class DeletingTextExample(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        text = Text("Deleting", color=PURPLE).scale(1.5).to_edge(LEFT)
        cursor = Rectangle(
            color = GREY_A,
            fill_color = GREY_A,
            fill_opacity = 1.0,
            height = 1.1,
            width = 0.5,
        ).move_to(text[0]) # Position the cursor

        self.play(UntypeWithCursor(text, cursor))
        self.play(Blink(cursor, blinks=2))
